# DECISIONS.md — signed decisions (Tope is the only approver)

Format: `ID | date | decision | options considered | chosen | signed by | affects (RTM/cards)`. A waiver is `Waived-by-Tope` only when it appears here.

## Awaiting Tope (G0 — surfaced during card drafting; none blocks G0 approval, each blocks the card listed)

| ID | Decision | Options | Recommended | Source | Blocks |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| D20 | Curriculum UI while no language is verified | (a) coming-soon and no lesson list for every language until E-P4/E-P5 fills the verified set; (b) keep showing bundled lessons with a banner | **(a)** — AC4 plus the marketing freeze | P1-029 | P1-029 |

D1–D10 signed 2026-10-21 ("approve all as recommended").

| D11 | Age at sign-up. Tope 2026-10-23. Replaces the 2026-10-22 wording. | **Ask for birth year, not a full date of birth. Age for the band is the current calendar year minus the birth year minus one, so a child is not treated as older before that year ends. Under the country child threshold (default 13) is child mode: verifiable parental consent before any account data is stored; no open social, chat, or marketplace; no ads; moderated AI only. Historical Personas free chat stays and runs under child-safe moderation. From the child threshold through 17 is teen mode: private profile, no direct messages from adults. Thresholds live in per-country config. The default child threshold is 13 and the example override is 16. Features are gated, not removed. Social messages stay readable by the platform. Transport stays HTTPS.** | Tope, this session |
| D25 | JWT rotation. Tope 2026-10-22: no revocation | **Keep accepting the current HS256 secret. Do not wait on key revocation. A later asymmetric key must not reject installed sessions.** | Tope, this session |
| D26 | Certificate pinning (P1-054). Tope 2026-10-22 | **Leaf DER SHA-256 on iOS and Android. CERTIFICATE_PIN_HASHES holds the current pin and the next pin. A release with pins fails closed. A build with no pins stays open.** | Tope, this session |
| ADR-004 | Local database. Tope 2026-10-22, owner-approved | **Drift (SQLite). Not Isar.** Hive is what the app uses today. Drift has ordered SQL migrations, encryption through SQLCipher, and current Flutter support. Isar is faster for some document reads and its maintenance has stalled. P2-014 through P2-030 are unblocked. | Tope, this session |
| D12 | Trusted user for auto-hide. Tope 2026-10-22, owner-approved | **(a)** Verified native and reputation at or above a config threshold. Stewards always count. | CURRICULUM L616 |
| D13 | Tone-accuracy gate. Tope 2026-10-22, owner-approved | **(a)** At least 90% native-judged tone accuracy on a 100-item set. Config default, with a per-language override. | ELEVATION L1460 |

This is the curated set only. Free open-ended chat with any African historical figure stays and is not removed or gated off. | ELEVATION §8 |

| D17 | Release guardrails. Tope 2026-10-22, owner-approved | **Crash-free users at least 99.5%. ANR rate under 0.47%.** Heritage Fund percent and marketplace share stay blank config until EXT-03. | ELEVATION L1957 |
| D18 | UI translation sign-off. Tope 2026-10-22, owner-approved | **A named native reviewer per locale signs off.** Tope approves the list. | ELEVATION §13.8 |

| P2-032 | Atlas backups. Tope 2026-10-22, owner-approved | **Continuous backup with point-in-time restore, and one documented test restore.** | Tope, this session |
| P1-004 | Secrets manager. Tope 2026-10-22, owner-approved. Destination superseded by D27 on 2026-10-23. | **No secrets in the repo or the client.** Key migration stays at the end of the build. | Tope, this session |
| D27 | Secrets vault. Tope 2026-10-23. | **Doppler.** The backend reads secrets from Doppler when `DOPPLER_TOKEN` is set. A `.env` file is the fallback for local development and tests only. Until the token exists, production keeps the current process environment so the API stays up. That bridge is a builder default, Tope may override. Creating the Doppler project and a service token is a switch-on. Moving the keys already in the tree stays at the end of the build (D24). | Tope, this session |
| P2-021 | On-device tone package. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **20 MB.** No model is selected. The hook stays unavailable until a commercial-licence model meets the D13 floor. | builder default |
| P2-030 | Background queue. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **Keep Bull, the client already installed.** A second BullMQ client is not added. Cron runs in the worker process, and the PM2 worker count stays 1 until a shared lease store is connected. The API process does not start workers. | builder default |
| P2-035 | AI fallback alert. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **Alert when more than 20 percent of AI calls in 15 minutes used a fallback.** A missing price is unknown, not zero. | builder default |
| P2-039 | Shorebird. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **Do not enable Shorebird.** Store fixes keep the existing rollout stages. A patch channel stays off until Tope signs it on. | builder default |
| P2-040 | Root markdown keep list. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **Keep HANDOFF.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, and STATUS.md at the repo root.** AGENTS.md and README.md stay as well. The other root Markdown files move to docs/archive/status. | builder default |
| P2-043 | FSRS-6 fuzzing and mastery. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **Fuzzing stays off.** BKT still updates mastery. A store that only keeps whole days uses an empty learning-step list. | builder default |
| P2-044 | Mutation operators. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **Arithmetic, relational, equality, and logical operators, plus boolean literals, exact 0 and 1 literals, and a dropped unary minus.** A mutant that does not compile is not scored. The floor stays 80 percent even if the yaml threshold is lower. | builder default |
| P2-045 | Graph event payload and strength. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **A graph event carries nodeId, kind, rating, channel, and correct, plus optional sense and error.** Strength on a channel is correct answers divided by attempts. Missing nodeId stores the event and creates no node. Raw audio is never stored on the node. | builder default |
| P2-046 | Due, weak, and Polie context. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **A node is due on its learning or relearning step, otherwise on the FSRS day interval. Weak means recall under 0.9 or any error count. Equal recall ranks the higher error count first. Polie receives at most 5 weak items and no learner id.** | builder default |
| P2-047 | Item bank shape. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **An item id and a skill tag are ASCII. Skill tags are the graph node ids copied onto the answer event. A draft is stored and is not served. IRT a must be greater than 0 and b is required. Calibration stays on P2-049. Multiple choice needs a rationale on every distractor.** | builder default |
| P2-048 | Legacy quiz import. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **Language, history, random, and unit quizzes become item-bank items. A distractor rationale uses the author rationale, fun fact, or hint, otherwise that option's own text. Bracket questions stay sentence building. Placeholder text is not imported. Unpublished questions are not served. Uncalibrated items store IRT a of 1 and b of 0 until P2-049.** | builder default |
| P2-049 | IRT calibration. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **Logistic 2PL on a standard normal scale. An item needs 200 unique pilot persons and both outcomes before its a and b are written and marked calibrated. A later response from the same person replaces the earlier one. Fit is the RMS residual at that person's EAP ability. Scoring reads only calibrated parameters. The job runs when invoked, not on a cron.** | builder default |
| P2-050 | CAT placement. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **Logistic 2PL. Fewer than 8 calibrated items is provisional and unsure, with no ability. Otherwise the test gives 8 to 15 items and stops after 8 once the standard error is at or below 0.45. It never continues past 15. The interval is the ability plus or minus 1.96 standard errors. The person prior is standard normal. A tie takes the lower item id. The CEFR label is the band of the point estimate and does not replace the interval. Static questions stay uncalibrated, so the current onboarding result is unsure.** | builder default |
| P2-051 | Listening, tone, and picture items. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **A listen item plays the item-bank audio ref. Grading follows the answer spec, and diacritic-insensitive matching folds tone marks and underdots to base letters. A tone item is graded only against the lexeme tone pattern, compared as case-insensitive syllable tokens. A picture with blank alt text is rejected.** | builder default |
| P2-052 | Dictation and sentence building. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **One known combining mark is composed before grading. A missing tone mark is a diacritic error and is not fully correct. A listed ASCII variant passes with a hint. A sentence passes only when the token order is one of the item's accepted orderings.** | builder default |
| P2-053 | Speaking prompts. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **A score is shown only when the pronounce endpoint returns a finite score and a finite confidence, both from 0 to 1, and the payload is not a fallback. Confidence below 0.6 hides the number and shows unsure. Any other result is unavailable and shows no number. The recording is discarded unless the learner opted in to storage.** | builder default |
| P2-054 | Conversation can-dos. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **A can-do is met only when a scored turn cites it, confidence is at least 0.6, and the turn is met. Thin evidence is unsure and is not met. If the scorer is unavailable, nothing is stored.** | builder default |
| P2-055 | Item feedback. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **Feedback shows the correct form, and the audio control only when the item has an audio ref. A wrong answer shows the content-team rationale sentence. A blank rationale shows the correct form only and flags the item. No rationale is invented.** | builder default |
| P2-056 | Unit checkpoints. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **A checkpoint keeps only items whose can-dos belong to the unit. Evidence stores item ids, scores, and calibration, and is issued only when every item is calibrated and any required scorer result is real. Proctoring is recorded only for the Passport with explicit consent. That flag is the consent rule, not a completed proctoring session.** | builder default |
| P2-057 | First-use tips. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **Each preloader appears once as a tip for its feature. Dismissal is stored and does not show again. The features guide and the game onboarding overlay stay, and Settings links to both.** | builder default |
| P2-058 | Per-skill mastery. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **Mastery is a Beta-Binomial with prior alpha 1 and beta 1. It moves only from the practice signals on the event. A missing pronunciation or tone score is not filled in. The under-16 record is the skill estimate only. Reset returns every skill to that prior.** | builder default |
| P3-001 | Competitor baselines. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **A baseline number is recorded only with a source. After 12 searches and a recount of the local Duolingo captures, three numbers are sourced and the other rows stay blank. The card stays Draft. No missing tap count, latency, or text size is filled in.** | builder default |
| P4-001 | Licence register. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **A row missing a required field fails by name. Use flags must be true or false. An unsigned row cannot set display or training. A non-commercial or share-alike licence cannot set display or training. Evidence-only is allowed. The shipped register has a header and no rows.** | builder default |
| P4-002 | Public-domain seed. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **FSI Yoruba, Igbo, Hausa, and Swahili are public-domain, confirmed, and marked to modernise 1960s vocabulary. They stay evidence-only until EXT-03. Peace Corps rows are labelled public-domain with pd_status unconfirmed, so display and training stay false until each item is verified. There is no FSI Zulu or Xhosa course. The Zulu kit names Poulos & Msimang [purchase] and does not add it to the register. Xhosa has no named grammar; the kit quotes the curriculum line that a linguist must choose.** | builder default |
| P4-003 | Share-alike seed. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **Wiktionary/Kaikki, UD Yoruba-YTB, UD Naija-NSC, and the Biblica Yoruba and Hausa rows are evidence-only. Display and training stay false because the licence is share-alike. Wiktionary is not copied into the proprietary lexicon. A Biblica derivative that still says Biblica fails. Bible rows are religious-register and allow only corpus or frequency evidence. Owner signoff stays empty until EXT-03.** | builder default |
| P4-004 | CC BY seed. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **Leipzig downloads are CC BY. Web services and applications stay excluded as CC BY-NC. FLEURS is CC BY 4.0 for yo, ig, ha, sw, xh, and zu. WAXAL is two licence groups because §2.2 does not name subsets: Ghana CC BY 4.0, and the other group CC BY-SA 4.0. African Storybook keeps only CC BY stories with an author. Display and training stay false until EXT-03. Common Voice is the next card.** | builder default |
| P4-005 | Common Voice hours. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **Common Voice is CC0, so display, evidence, and training are permitted, and attribution may be empty. The display and training flags stay false until EXT-03. Hours are Yoruba 8.3 (26.0), Hausa 12.6, Igbo 18.9, and Swahili 1065 (27.0). Hausa and Igbo have no version in §2.2. Zulu and Xhosa hours are unverified and are not zero.** | builder default |
| P4-006 | Igbo Storybook count. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **On 2026-10-23 the live African Storybook homepage was an Apache test page, and one story URL returned 404. A search index quotes Igbo and Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 for three story URLs, and quotes 5513 storybooks for the whole catalogue. That is not an Igbo count. The register stays unverified. Recording none would be false.** | builder default |
| P4-007 | Discovery and tiers. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **Lanfrica is discovery only. Display, evidence, and training stay false, and an item cannot cite it until the dataset's own source is verified. The checklist tiers are T1, T2, T3, T4a, T4b, and T5 from arXiv 2606.28867 Table 1. Peace Corps is not T1 while pd_status is unconfirmed. Leipzig and the WAXAL Ghana row are not marked as a clean CC-BY tier, because that paper contradicts a blanket reading. A missing checklist entry fails.** | builder default |
| P4-008 | Counsel gate. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **No row has counsel_status confirmed. Display or training true fails with COUNSEL_PENDING even when an owner has signed. Verbatim copy needs a register id and attribution. It is allowed only when the checklist tier T1 or T2 is yes, the public-domain status is not unconfirmed, and the source is not discovery-only. The G4 licence gate returns Blocked-External EXT-03. This card is not Done.** | builder default |
| P4-009 | Share-alike containment. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **Share-alike text, including a BY-SA or GFDL licence, cannot enter the lexicon, learner text, or the proprietary lexicon. It can sit in the evidence layer only with attribution. Verbatim copy still goes through the counsel-gate check. The content-engine workflow fails when the containment tests fail. Branch protection is not set from this card.** | builder default |
| P4-010 | Non-commercial exclusion. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **The §2.3 non-commercial and academic-only sources stay excluded, with every use false. No waiver or ELRA purchase is recorded. JW300 stays excluded as a terms breach. Oxford and the two classic dictionaries stay needs-licence. A manifest cannot lift a row. The table changes only when that row has a document reference and counsel confirmed. The content-engine job runs the tests. Branch protection is not set from this card.** | builder default |
| P2-041 | Learner graph. Builder default, Tope may override. 2026-10-23 | **One graph replaces the four models named in ADR-005.** Migration writes events first, then projects nodes, then FSRS-6 schedules, then the old writers stop being read. Raw audio stays off without opt-in. The four models are not deleted by this decision. | builder default |
| P1-010 | App integrity. Tope 2026-10-22, owner-approved | **Play Integrity on Android and App Attest on iOS. Log-only first.** Enforce on sensitive routes after the false-positive rate is reviewed. | Tope, this session |
| P1-025 | Snap storage. Tope 2026-10-22, owner-approved | **Private Cloudflare R2 bucket. Signed short-lived URLs only. No public listing.** | Tope, this session |

Affects: D1/D6 → CONFLICTS C1–C3 closed, ADR-001…003; D2–D5 → EXTERNAL EXT-04/05/06/11/12, P4 studio cards; D7 → 04_ROUTING.md locked pending 10-card calibration; D8 → 05_UX_DESIGN_BAR.md targets; D9 → EXT-01 stays Open until the file arrives; D10 → P3 typography cards.
